Description: Bauto is a Frankish military figure seeking standing within western Roman service. He is concerned with how to obtain a useful position without becoming trapped in a faction. He listens to experienced advisers but wants clear recognition of service rather than indefinitely postponed promises. Maintaining support requires service he can actually provide, while followers need food, reward and safety. An order that reserves glory for its author and blame for its executor makes him wary. He wants his judgement heard before a decision rather than being given responsibility only after it fails.
